subject: Genetics
title: De-Extinction Dreams
description: Learn De-Extinction Dreams in one minute.

hook.text: Colossal Biosciences wants to bring back the woolly mammoth. Not clone it—edit an elephant to become one.

buildup.text: Mammoth DNA was sequenced from frozen specimens.

discovery.text: CRISPR could insert mammoth genes into Asian elephant cells.

twist.text: Critics say de-extinction distracts from saving living species.

climax.text: Colossal raised $225 million. Whether or not it works, the tech developed may help conserve endangered species.

punchline.text: Bringing back the mammoth is a maybe. Saving the elephant is a must.

quiz.question: What approach would 'de-extinction' of mammoths actually use?
options: Editing elephant DNA with mammoth genes
